description: Main FastAPI application defining REST API endpoints for a nutrition tracker backend, including user authentication, food entry CRUD, and nutrition data endpoints.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify the API is running.

methods.name: register_user(data: UserRegister)
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user.

methods.name: login_user(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Endpoint to obtain JWT token upon user login.

methods.name: add_food_entry( entry: FoodEntryCreate, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Create a new food log entry for the authenticated user.

methods.name: list_food( date_filter: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="(Optional) Date to filter entries"), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieve a list of food entries, optionally filtered by date.

methods.name: get_food( entry_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieve a specific food entry by ID.

methods.name: update_food( entry_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), entry: FoodEntryUpdate = ..., user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Update an existing food entry by ID.

methods.name: delete_food( entry_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Delete a food entry by ID.

methods.name: dashboard( for_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Date for the dashboard (defaults to today)"), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Get nutritional summary for a specific day.

methods.name: nutrition_history( user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieve user's nutrition history for analytics.

methods.name: fetch_macros( for_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Date to fetch calories/macros for (defaults to today)"), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Get total macros and calories for a specific day.
